_meta.title: Share of federal individual income tax paid, by income group
_meta.source: IRS Statistics of Income, individual tables by tax rate and income percentile, tax year 2023. CBO Distribution of Household Income 2022 for the top 1% income share
notes: INDIVIDUAL INCOME TAX ONLY. Excludes payroll tax, which is where most households below the top decile pay more. Any chart must say this.
Refundable credits are excluded from the IRS series, which overstates the effective rate at the bottom.
Tax year 2023 is the latest IRS year. The 1995 comparison point was not retrieved; 2001 (33.2%) is the earliest verified anchor.
Concentration of tax paid tracks concentration of income. Show both columns or the chart misleads.
